The issuer demonstrates solid profitability with revenue of \$8.63B and an operating income of \$806M, alongside a moderate short-term liquidity profile represented by a current ratio of 1.30. Most notably, the balance sheet exhibits an exceptionally low leverage profile with total liabilities of only \$11M against \$3.34B in shareholders' equity, resulting in virtually non-existent debt and an extremely strong solvency position. Despite the strong balance sheet, the relatively thin gross margin of 13% and modest size compared to global mega-cap issuers cap the rating in the upper-medium investment grade.

DECISION: A+
